name: development-claude-plugin
description: Plugin family for projects that ARE Claude Code plugins. v1 ships a test harness (/development-claude-plugin:test) that exercises plugin functionality against a real reference project via a fresh-context subagent driving a headless child `claude` session, returning a structured PASS/FAIL verdict without polluting the authoring context. Maintenance dispatcher and validation agents (version-sync, skill-validator, reference-checker, structure-validator) follow once issue #249's language-leakage fix lands.
